text:
maria.k: Heads up — hotfix ready to push to prod to restore background flush jobs. Need someone with prod push rights and MFA to run canary+prod.
amit.s: I don't have the deployer role in prod, MFA shows as 'unverified' on my account. :confused:
sam.o: I'm on the hands-off list for today (OOO). ops-oncall, can you cover?
ops-oncall: I can cover the window for a single push. What's the exact command and version we should pin?
maria.k: Pinning to v2.4.1-fix. Command: `deploy-bot deploy --env prod --version v2.4.1 --canary 10%` — docs: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/deploys
ryan.l: MFA service is flaky right now, ops team is rebooting the auth-proxy. If MFA won't verify, we can do a short-lived service-account claim: create temp-svcacct with just deploy permission, 30m TTL.
amit.s: Can you create the claim? I can verify and run the canary if ops-oncall creates the temp-svcacct.
ops-oncall: Creating temp svcacct now -> `svcacctctl create temp-deployer --role deployer --ttl 30m` ; will post token.
deploy-bot: temp-deployer token created at 1719999928, expires in 1800s. Use `deploy-bot auth --token <redacted>` to authenticate.
maria.k: Running canary now (10%): `deploy-bot deploy --env prod --version v2.4.1 --canary 10% --note "flush job fix"`
sam.o: :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Canary looks healthy after 6 mins, p95 latency ok, no increased errors in /flush endpoint.
amit.s: Proceed to full rollout in 3 minutes. Rollout command: `deploy-bot deploy --env prod --version v2.4.1 --rollout 100%`
ryan.l: One reminder — pin the release in console and add release-note: "v2.4.1: restore background flush job stability" so the monitoring alerts tie to rollout.
maria.k: Pinning now and adding notes.
ops-oncall: Full rollout started.
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed at 1719999965; version v2.4.1 serving 100%.
amit.s: Verified, background flush rate back to normal.
maria.k: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action: ops to finish auth-proxy restart and remove temp-deployer. ops-oncall, can you revoke?
ops-oncall: Revoking temp svcacct -> `svcacctctl revoke temp-deployer` done at 1719999970. :white_check_mark:
ryan.l: Filing short postmortem item: MFA flakiness caused temporary svcacct use. We'll add an item to harden auth-proxy and add clearer fallback steps to the release playbook.
maria.k: Created ticket INFRA-6123 and added the playbook change. Closing this thread.
